tests.input_scenario: Plan generated from old report with invalid schema/hash compared against current state
tests.expected_action: Refuse execution, flag plan as invalid/stale

tests.input_scenario: Target file in plan does not exist or was modified after plan generation
tests.expected_action: Refuse execution; flag target file as stale or missing
tests.actual_action: Task flagged as stale; execution blocked
tests.error_message: Target file was missing or hash deviated from plan snapshot

tests.input_scenario: Remediation target file contains relative escape path '../../etc/passwd'
tests.expected_action: Reject path, raise security violation, refuse execution
tests.actual_action: Path boundary validation threw security violation
tests.error_message: security violation: path traverses outside workspace: ../../etc/passwd

tests.input_scenario: Attempt targeting symlink path referencing directory outside isolated workspace
tests.actual_action: Path validator detected escape and blocked operation
tests.error_message: Target path resolves outside workspace boundary

tests.test_name: Remediation Plan with Circular Task Dependencies
tests.input_scenario: Task A depends on Task B, while Task B depends on Task A
tests.expected_action: Detect cyclic dependency graph, refuse execution ordering
tests.actual_action: Dependency resolver detected topological cycle and blocked execution
tests.error_message: Cycle detected in task execution graph: TASK-A -> TASK-B -> TASK-A

tests.input_scenario: Task specifies dependency ID 'TASK-NON-EXISTENT' which is not present in plan
tests.expected_action: Reject task scheduling, mark plan execution blocked
tests.error_message: Required dependency 'TASK-NON-EXISTENT' does not exist in plan

tests.input_scenario: Execution attempted on HumanApprovalRequired task without supplying approval token
tests.actual_action: Execution gate rejected task with EXEC_REJECTED_UNAPPROVED
tests.error_message: EXEC_REJECTED_UNAPPROVED: Task TASK-BYPASS-07 requires explicit human approval ()

tests.input_scenario: Approval token supplied but belongs to different task or contains invalid signature
tests.error_message: EXEC_REJECTED_UNAPPROVED: Task TASK-BYPASS-07 requires explicit human approval ()

tests.input_scenario: Patch introduces syntax error causing 'go build' to fail in isolated workspace
tests.expected_action: Validation failure detected, workspace rolled back, source untouched
tests.error_message: go build failed in isolated workspace

tests.input_scenario: Patch modifies code causing an existing unit test to fail
tests.expected_action: Detect test suite regression, abort integration, roll back workspace
tests.actual_action: IndependentValidator flagged test suite failure and failed validation
tests.error_message: go test failed in isolated workspace

tests.input_scenario: Patch eliminates primary defect but introduces a hardcoded secret vulnerability
tests.expected_action: Detect regression during post-remediation diagnostic scan; reject patch
tests.actual_action: Security analyzer detected new critical secret finding

tests.input_scenario: Build or test process hangs or exceeds configured execution timeout limit
tests.expected_action: Terminate subprocess cleanly, record timeout failure, discard workspace
tests.actual_action: Execution timeout triggered and terminated execution context

tests.test_name: Workspace Disk / File Size Quota Exceeded
tests.input_scenario: Remediation task attempts to write files exceeding workspace quota (100MB)
tests.expected_action: Abort write, enforce storage ceiling, clean up workspace
tests.actual_action: Storage quota guard enforced workspace byte ceiling
tests.error_message: Workspace size exceeded quota limit of 104857600 bytes

tests.input_scenario: 4 remediation workspaces created and destroyed concurrently under same parent
tests.expected_action: Ensure isolated namespaces without path collisions or file locking conflicts
tests.actual_action: All 4 concurrent workspaces executed and cleaned up without conflict
tests.error_message: Zero race conditions or file locking conflicts detected

tests.test_name: Workspace Disposal and Residual Artifact Cleanup
tests.input_scenario: Untracked temporary artifacts left in workspace prior to DestroyWorkspace
tests.expected_action: Recursively remove entire workspace directory; zero orphaned files
tests.actual_action: Workspace directory completely destroyed; os.Stat confirmed non-existence
tests.error_message: Zero residual files persisted after destruction

tests.test_name: Malformed or Truncated JSON Remediation Plan
tests.input_scenario: Remediation plan file corrupted with unparseable syntax or truncated bytes
tests.expected_action: Reject plan during ingestion; fail with syntax parsing error
tests.actual_action: JSON unmarshaler failed with unexpected EOF error

tests.input_scenario: Target file in repository differs from expected hash recorded in plan
tests.expected_action: Abort remediation task; refuse to apply patch on modified file
tests.actual_action: Integrity check detected cryptographic hash mismatch
